data.name: Genesis
data.detailed_description:
Enter an abandoned village where silence hides something far worse than decay. Genesis is a first-person survival horror experience where every shadow threatens to reveal the monster stalking you.

You are not alone.
The creature hunts relentlessly, forcing you to scavenge what little remains: revolver rounds, bandages, and scattered notes that hold the key to your escape. Each discovery brings you closer to freedom — or face-to-face with what lurks in the dark.

Features

  • First-person survival horror set in a desolate, abandoned village

  • A terrifying monster that hunts and chases you without mercy

  • Collect scattered notes to unravel the path to escape

  • Manage scarce resources: revolver, bandages, and precious ammo

  • Tense atmosphere with constant dread and no safe place to hide

Will you escape the village, or will the monster make Genesis your final chapter?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, runs best at 1080p/1440p

content_descriptors.notes: Creepy looking monster and bloody body bags can be seen.
